'''Brandon Blonch''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[September 2000 Green Bay tournament (2 September)]] on 2 September 2000 with [[Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed|RST (borrowed from the tournament director)]], according to Mark Kloida's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1203">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-05-gb-9-2-00d1203/ gb-9-2-00], DeckTech (Mark "yodarth" Kloida, 5 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-05-gb-9-2-00d1203/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
